_note: M2 AN2 item 2: the clips tools/blender/build_soldier_clips.py bakes from the Quaternius UAL (CC0) onto the soldier's 22-bone rig, and the cleaning numbers. name = the clip name Godot sees (looping clips are exported as <name>_Loop and loop); src = the UAL clip. ik: legs re-solved to the scaled source feet with ground, pinning and reach (fix_legs). gait: the locomotion slot whose ground speed the clip's natural speed is compared with. stride: the feet's fore-aft offset from the pelvis scaled; stance_time: stance frames play this long (the flight frames longer, same cycle), both raise the natural ground speed; lean_deg: extra forward lean of the upper body. lock_hips_xz: the pelvis keeps its mean ground position (SoldierGait turns the feet about it for the strafes). carry_neck: the neck rides the chest top (the clip's consumer carries it). arms: forearms and hands kept out of the torso. ground: the posed mesh's lowest vertex on y = 0 every frame. subloop: the reviver's working loop (data/anim_third_person.json poses.revive keys) closed. Presentation numbers, not design values (OQ-ANIM).

clean._note: pin_extra_m: a sole point counts as planted within data/anim_third_person.json gait.contact_height_m plus this of the floor; pin_release_frames: how fast a released foot's pin correction fades; toe_bend_max_deg: how far the toes may bend up to stay on the floor; leg_reach_max: fraction of the leg length an ankle may be from the hip joint (the pelvis drops beyond); seam_frames: frames blended into the loop start; arm_margin_m / arm_step_deg / arm_max_deg: the forearm-torso clearance and the upper-arm turn search; ground_blur_frames: smoothing of the ground fix; press_frames: a new stance eases its lowest planted point onto the floor over this many frames; ground_percentile: the clip's stance level (a low percentile of each foot's lowest sole point per frame) goes to y = 0; pin_speed_tol_mps / pin_speed_tol_frac: how far a near-ground point's speed may differ from the natural ground speed and still count as planted; swing_clear_extra_m: an unplanted foot keeps its sole this far above the contact height; subloop_seam_frames: frames blended into a sub-loop's start.
